people.designer: Give the graphics to the designer

mockup.none: No mockup yet. Its picture shows here.

next.title: What happens next
next.DRAFT: The order is still a draft. Confirm it when every line has its product.
next.SENT: The customer sent it. Check it and confirm the order.
next.CONFIRMED: Confirmed: waits for the print. Print and start the work, then the baskets go to the floor.
next.IN_PRODUCTION: The baskets are on the floor. Each department passes them on.
next.SHIPPED: It left the factory and is on its way.
next.AT_OUR_WAREHOUSE: It waits at our warehouse. Send it on to the customer.
next.WITHDRAWN: The order was withdrawn. Nothing more happens.

floor.label: On the floor
floor.failed: The floor setting could not be saved. Try again.

text.title: The order as it was written
text.lines: The lines in the customer’s words
text.notice: This order came as text. Read it and pick the product of each line. Then you can confirm.

cf.promiseHint: You promise this day. The customer sees it. Change it later on Production › Change the promise….
cf.promisePast: This day is in the past. Promise today or a later day.
cf.openTitle_one: {count} detail still open. You can confirm now.
cf.openTitle_other: {count} details still open. You can confirm now.
cf.openWhy: The design work and the pattern can start. The history keeps that you confirmed with open details.
cf.pickProductWhy: Line {seq} has no product yet. Pick it here or in the sheet; then you can confirm.
cf.failed: The order could not be confirmed. Try again.
cf.readFailed: This order could not be read. Close and try again.

log.chipsLabel: Show the changes of one kind
log.emptyChip: No change of this kind yet.

notices.title: The customer says it paid
notices.info: The customer tells the factory it paid. A notice changes nothing that is owed: record the payment with Record payment… when it is in the bank.
notices.failed: The notice could not be answered. Try again.
notices.thenRecord: Recorded means you saw it: record the payment itself with Record payment… (with your code).

money.paidTooMuch: {amount} is paid too much: the order’s total went below what is paid.

zip.failed: The zip could not be made. Try again.
zip.leftOut_one: {count} file was left out of the zip: you cannot open it.
zip.leftOut_other: {count} files were left out of the zip: you cannot open them.

design.noPicture: Choose the order’s picture (the mockup) first: it is what the customer approves.
design.waits: The customer already has the design to approve.
design.failed: The design could not be sent. Try again.
design.question: Please approve the design of order {number}. The work goes on meanwhile; your approval makes it sure.

state.WAITS: Design: waits for the customer’s approval
state.CHANGE: Design: the customer asks a change
